criteria.text: Identifies that the core platform was developed by contractor Saltash Holdings Ltd without a written IP assignment, so the Company may not own it, and recommends obtaining a confirmatory assignment as a condition to Closing.
States that General Warranty claims must be notified by 6 April 2028 (12 months after Closing) and Fundamental Warranty claims by 6 April 2030 (36 months after Closing).
Calculates the long-stop date as 26 May 2027 (90 days after signing on 25 February 2027) and identifies that expected clearance on 10 July 2027 falls after it, recommending an extension.
States the survival periods as durations and as dates (6 April 2028; 6 April 2030) and gives days remaining to the general-warranty expiry from 15 March 2027 (388 days).
Opens with a short 'Bottom line' / executive summary stating the overall conclusion and the most important risks before the detailed analysis.
Checks whether computed deadlines fall on a weekend and adjusts them under the documents' Business Day definition.
